title: 35C3 -  Modchips of the State
summary: A 35C3 talk presenting a proof-of-concept SPI bus hardware implant with capabilities like those alleged in the Bloomberg Supermicro story, plus countermeasures for detecting such modchips.
why: HN cites it as a demonstration that the supply-chain implant attack described in the Bloomberg story is technically feasible.
